title: Immediate purchase impressions and vague customer-status notes
summary: This topic combines enthusiastic first-impression purchase comments with many context-poor service or status statements about what the customer knew or had at the moment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe instant attraction to the vehicle’s appearance and confidence that it was the right car upon first seeing it.

negative.summary: The negative review reports the customer contacting BMW about a known issue and being told an update would be sent to correct it.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews are mostly incomplete status notes about the customer not being with the vehicle or not having time, plus one unclear comment about feeling unrecognized on arrival.

limitations: Most examples are brief and lack enough context to determine a clear sentiment.
The cluster mixes showroom first-impression comments with service-log style status statements, so it is not a single coherent issue.
The undetermined examples are especially fragmentary, limiting reliable interpretation of the underlying customer experience.
